existing_root_classifier.new: nonexistent output root; create mode 0700 through a trusted parent directory FD
existing_root_classifier.initialization_incomplete: only a strict initialization prefix before one exact valid revision-1 task exists; a parsed revision-1-or-later task can never match this branch; return archive_run_initialization_incomplete without repair, deletion, or Docker
existing_root_classifier.terminal_canceled: exact revision-2 canceled task with the revision-1 no-side-effect inventory and legal submitted,input_validated,canceled event prefix returns archive_run_terminal_canceled; no resume, recovery, finalization, or Docker is allowed
existing_root_classifier.terminal_failed: exact revision-3-or-4 failed task with legal failed event prefix, verified-absent owned resources, closed run-journal/receipt inventory, no success summary, and either no pre-CAS success artifact or the exact immutable revision-3 forensic prefix already present before recovery returns archive_run_terminal_failed; retained forensic evidence/success-intent bytes are never exposed as a successful bundle and no resume, recovery, finalization, replay-success, or Docker is allowed
existing_root_classifier.revision_one_resume: resume only the exact revision_one_resume inventory with matching tenant/idempotency/ER3RunBinding and no setup/resource/operation artifact
existing_root_classifier.revision_two_or_three: return archive_run_recovery_required only when recovery_prefix_grammar accepts the exact task, journal, and complete-or-journaled command prefix; ordinary er3-run never invokes prepare or execute
existing_root_classifier.revision_four_without_summary: return archive_run_finalize_required only when run-summary.json is absent and the exact summary_publication candidate grammar is empty or recoverable; only er3-finalize may publish the intent-bound summary
existing_root_classifier.complete: reject as already complete only after externally hash-bound summary and complete closed inventory validate; normalize only the exact same-inode summary-candidate crash state under the exclusive lease
existing_root_classifier.mismatch_or_unknown: a preexisting unbound, malformed, mismatched, linked, special, or independently-inoded summary is included here and is never replaced; fail archive_run_authorization_mismatch or export_replay_mismatch without creating another root, mutating ordinary artifacts, or invoking Docker

pre_side_effect_inventories.classification_lock: every root existence check, creation, classification, resume, recovery, finalization, inventory snapshot, and summary publication occurs while holding run_artifact_contract.run_level_lease outside the run root
pre_side_effect_inventories.initialization_rule: root creation, control-directory creation, private-Docker copy publication, control-receipt publication, store initialization, and revision-1 create may leave a strict prefix only on crash; every such prefix is initialization_incomplete and is never an ordinary resume shape
pre_side_effect_inventories.revision_one_resume_conditional_file: state/store/tenant-v1-<sha256(tenant_id)>/idempotency.json exists if and only if idempotency_key is non-null and contains exactly that one task binding
pre_side_effect_inventories.revision_one_resume_file_rules: control/docker and every JSON/lease byte, mode, owner, digest, tenant/task identity, revision-1 event prefix, selector, idempotency preimage, and complete ER3RunBinding match the reviewed command and golden/live schemas; no temporary, staging, symlink, hardlink, special, ignored, setup, ownership, Docker-control, operation, success-intent, or summary path exists

interrupted_run.predicate: v2 running task is revision 2 or 3, has immutable er3_run_binding and recall_started, has no terminal event, and the exact recovery_prefix_grammar validates
interrupted_run.automatic_retry_policy: create retry, idempotency retry, restart, and ordinary er3-run never invoke prepare or execute again
interrupted_run.successful_recovery: acquire the persistent-inode run-level lease then the store writer lease, validate every tenant/task/ER3RunBinding identity and the closed journal/receipt/phase-artifact prefix, use only the private Docker copy and exact bound socket, remove only journaled or uniquely pair-labeled resources authorized by the durable zero proof, prove container/volume/network absence, retain any exact immutable pre-revision-4 success-artifact prefix as forensic bytes without publishing a summary, close the journal, and CAS to failed with code archive_run_interrupted, recovered true, cleanup_status verified_absent
interrupted_run.recovery_prohibitions: never open fixture bytes, invoke index/search, rebuild evidence, or emit a success summary
interrupted_run.cleanup_failure: leave task running, exit archive_cleanup_failed, and allow only another explicit recovery attempt

recovery_prefix_grammar.journal_publication: under the exclusive run lease, create state/.run-journal.next with O_WRONLY|O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_CLOEXEC|O_NOFOLLOW mode 0600, write one complete canonical candidate, fsync its FD, validate it as exactly one legal successor of the current journal, atomically os.replace it over state/run-journal.json through retained directory FDs, and fsync state; never truncate or rewrite the authoritative journal in place; before every one of the 9 setup, 22 sealed-operation, 44 inspection, and 4 ordinary cleanup commands persist phase, class-local sequence, operation, exact argv digest, and pending_command stage=prepared; after subprocess return persist stage=result_recorded with exact stream/exit/control identity digests before publishing receipt artifacts; after the complete artifact group is fsynced append its receipt digest and clear pending_command
recovery_prefix_grammar.journal_candidate_recovery: state/.run-journal.next is the sole conditional partial journal path: with the exclusive run lease held, a missing current journal accepts only the exact initial candidate; when current is valid, a complete candidate must be exactly one legal successor and is promoted, an incomplete bounded regular candidate is unlinked and state fsynced without Docker or task mutation, and any complete non-successor, linked/special/oversized candidate, second temp path, or invalid current journal is mismatch_or_unknown with no deletion; terminal success and failed inventories forbid the candidate
revision_two_phase_artifact_order: mode-0700 empty docker-config-empty and docker-home-empty directories, then receipts/preflight/docker-environment.json before setup command 1
setup command groups 1..3 establish the three zero proofs
setup command groups 4..7 through container create
receipts/preflight/resource-ownership.json immediately after setup command 7 result identifies the created container
setup command groups 8..9 start and inspect the container
recovery_prefix_grammar.revision_two_valid_prefix: exact revision-2 running task plus complete revision-1 inventory, one valid journal or its sole atomic candidate state, and one exact prefix of revision_two_phase_artifact_order; command positions accept at most the one journaled pending setup group and its exact artifact-file prefix; each non-command artifact appears only after all named prerequisites and is itself complete, canonical, fsynced, and cross-bound; inputs/verified-fixture-set.json may exist before the revision-3 CAS; no operation, evidence, success-intent, or summary artifact is allowed
recovery_prefix_grammar.revision_three_command_chronology: for operation n=1..22 the sole global command order is inspection sequence 2n-1, operation sequence n, inspection sequence 2n; a valid prefix may stop or hold the sole pending command at any one of those three positions, so a completed before-inspection never requires the operation and a completed operation never requires its after-inspection until that next prefix position
revision_three_phase_artifact_order: complete accepted revision-2 prepare artifacts including inputs/verified-fixture-set.json
the exact revision_three_command_chronology prefix with index raw and normalized response pairs emitted only after their corresponding successful index-add operations
receipts/index/receipt-set.json only after all three index pairs
receipts/search/post-index.json only after the post-index search operation
receipts/service-identity.json and receipts/score-mapping-ruleset.json only after their complete source receipts
ordinary cleanup command prefix and verified-absent resource state
receipts/runtime-seal.json only after all 22 operations, 44 inspections, and required cleanup receipts
task/task.json, evidence/evidence-pack.json, evidence/evidence.md, evidence/audit-bundle.json, and state/success-intent.json as an exact fsynced pre-revision-4 success-artifact prefix
recovery_prefix_grammar.revision_three_valid_prefix: exact revision-3 running task plus one exact prefix of revision_three_phase_artifact_order; command positions accept at most one journaled pending inspection, operation, cleanup, or recovery-discovery command and its exact artifact-file prefix; derived and success artifacts appear only at their named prerequisite boundary and a complete success-intent before the revision-4 CAS remains a recoverable revision-3 prefix; no revision-4 store task or run-summary exists
recovery_prefix_grammar.recovery_discovery_prefix: only when setup zero proofs are complete but a created container ID is absent because create may have succeeded before result_recorded publication, er3-recover first records one fixed pair-label-filtered container-list command under receipts/recovery-discovery; zero matches proves no delete is needed, exactly one dual-label match binds the cleanup target, and any second match, volume/network match, malformed result, or command failure returns archive_run_recovery_evidence_incomplete without deletion; recovery-discovery receipts are journaled with the same atomic command protocol, are allowed only in interrupted/terminal-failed roots, and never occur in a successful inventory
recovery_prefix_grammar.cleanup_prefix: after any required recovery-discovery receipt, explicit recovery may append only a zero-to-four complete ordinary cleanup prefix in docker-rm, container-list, volume-list, network-list order; docker-rm is omitted only when the durable created ID and the discovery result both prove no owned container exists; a journaled pending cleanup command is accepted only under the same prepared/result_recorded/artifact-prefix rule
recovery_prefix_grammar.ownership_authority: destructive cleanup requires all three complete setup zero-proof list receipts plus either the journaled exact created ID or the exact one-container recovery-discovery result matching both unguessable labels; before zero proof, on zero-or-ambiguous authority, on any pair-labeled volume/network, or on journal/control identity drift, recovery performs no deletion and returns archive_run_recovery_evidence_incomplete
recovery_prefix_grammar.invalid_partial_policy: an unjournaled command artifact outside the sole journal-candidate rule, non-prefix command or phase artifact, second pending command, truncated or mismatched completed artifact, task/journal sequence disagreement, forbidden success/summary entry, or extra path is mismatch_or_unknown; automated recovery performs no destructive action
recovery_prefix_grammar.crash_matrix_requirement: Gate A parameterizes every setup command and every operation/inspection/cleanup command at prepared, result_recorded, each artifact-prefix, receipt-complete, journal-complete, and task-CAS boundaries; only grammar-accepted prefixes may reach cleanup
recovery_prefix_grammar.pending_command_types: command_class is setup|operation|inspection|cleanup; sequence is the class-local bounded positive integer; operation is the closed identifier; argv/environment/control identities and all result digests are 64 lowercase hex; stage is prepared|result_recorded; prepared requires exit/stream fields null and artifact_prefix_count 0; result_recorded requires integer exit, exact stream values, and artifact_prefix_count 0..4 or 0..5 only for inspection
recovery_prefix_grammar.completed_sequence_rules: each completed list is a duplicate-free contiguous prefix starting at 1 with maxima 9,22,44,4; its receipt paths and digests must exist completely and pending_command, when non-null, is exactly the next class-local sequence allowed by the global chronology
recovery_prefix_grammar.journal_integrity: strict I-JSON with exact fields and no self-authentication claim; before a success summary its authority comes from exclusive lease, durable ordered publication, task/binding equality, and closed artifact-prefix validation; corruption or ambiguity fails without deletion; the final summary later binds its exact bytes externally

completion_finalize.predicate: v2 task is revision 4 evidence_ready, success-intent is durable and exact, and the run-summary.json directory entry is absent; any existing exact externally hash-bound summary is complete, while any existing unbound, malformed, mismatched, linked, or special summary is mismatch_or_unknown and is never replaced
completion_finalize.actions: acquire the persistent-inode exclusive run-level lease then the store writer lease; validate ER3RunBinding, revision-4 store task, success-intent, every pre-summary artifact, closed store inventory, and verified-absent owned resources; enter the store export-freeze without closing its lease; publish through run_artifact_contract.summary_publication without replacing any existing summary entry; then close the store and release the run-level lease
completion_finalize.prohibitions: no Docker, fixture open, index/search, task event/revision, pack reconstruction, second output root, or external call
completion_finalize.failure: leave revision 4 and artifacts unchanged and return archive_completion_incomplete
completion_finalize.idempotency: if the exact summary already exists and its externally supplied digest matches, report already complete without writing; a conflicting existing entry always fails without overwrite, unlink, or repair

implementation_ancestry.required_chain: runtime_base -> owner-ratified design-lock head -> accepted Gate-A fail-first head -> Gate-B implementation head
implementation_ancestry.fail_first_baseline: Gate A adds only the ratified tests, manifest/synthetic fixtures, workflow, and verification document; Gate B remains blocked until the owner accepts that exact classified head

gate_a_fail_first_matrix.gate_a_head_expectation_rule: at the fail-first Gate-A head, the six named sequences pass because the ratified manifest/contract, existing v1 guards, required workflow, and classifier self-check are present; every other entry remains expected-red at its unchanged required_failure_boundary

failure_boundary_report_contract.test_action: an expected-red node reaches its named missing behavior and calls pytest.fail(required_failure_boundary, pytrace=False); no generic assertion, import/collection/setup/teardown error, or earlier exception is accepted

failure_boundary_report_contract.verifier_action: compare every exact node ID, phase outcome, and longrepr to the frozen matrix; a nonzero aggregate exit alone is never evidence

gate_a_fail_first_matrix.aggregate_requirement: against runtime_base, 104 nodes fail at exact markers and sequences 28/34 pass; at the Gate-A head, 100 nodes fail at those same exact markers and sequences 2/28/30/34/66/97 pass; both runs have exact collection and nonzero pytest exit

invariants: entry_count is 4 and unique_source_count is 3 for the ratified manifest
every manifest entry appears exactly once with identical id, role, source path, runtime name, size, and digest
query-exact-001 and archive-exact-001 bind the same one-open immutable bytes
verified_fixture_set_sha256 is canonical_sha256 after removing only verified_fixture_set_sha256
the canonical artifact is durably written and its digest is persisted in revision 3 before controller.execute

trusted_output_parent.path_policy: --out is absolute and lexically normalized; every existing parent component is opened from a trusted root by retained directory FD with O_DIRECTORY|O_CLOEXEC|O_NOFOLLOW, owned by root or the trusted runner, and not group/other writable
trusted_output_parent.identity_policy: bind the complete parent-chain identities plus final parent device/inode and run-root basename; revalidate path-entry-to-FD identity before lease access, classification, root creation, recovery/finalization, inventory, and summary publication
trusted_output_parent.alias_policy: lease naming uses only the validated parent directory entry and validated run-root basename, so aliases resolving to the same parent device/inode cannot create an independent writer lease
trusted_output_parent.creation_policy: create a nonexistent run root directory-FD-relative with mode 0700 and reject any preexisting symlink, hardlink-like alias, non-directory, owner/mode drift, or mutable untrusted ancestor

run_level_lease.path: a sibling .<run-root-basename>.review-reuse-er3.lock below the same trusted parent directory; it is outside the run root and therefore outside artifacts
run_level_lease.open_policy: open directory-FD-relative with O_RDWR|O_CREAT|O_CLOEXEC|O_NOFOLLOW mode 0600; require one owner-matching regular file with st_nlink 1 and no group/other write bit; record the directory-entry and locked-FD device/inode and require equality
run_level_lease.locking: er3-run, er3-recover, and er3-finalize acquire nonblocking exclusive flock before checking or creating the run root and retain it across classification, all task/Docker work, store export-freeze/inventory, summary publication, and parent-directory fsync; er3-replay acquires nonblocking shared flock for its complete two-inventory read; before each phase revalidate that the persistent path still names the locked device/inode
run_level_lease.reentry: all four ER3 subcommands use the same derived lease path; an exclusive-lock loser or replay that cannot acquire its shared lock returns archive_run_writer_conflict before reading mutable run state or invoking Docker; concurrent read-only replays may share the lease
run_level_lease.release: mutators unlock/close only after durable summary publication or a fully persisted failure/recovery outcome; replay releases only after its second unchanged inventory; never unlink, rename, truncate, or replace the lease path; process death releases the kernel lock but the permanent directory entry preserves one-inode locking semantics
run_level_lease.inventory_relationship: the store writer lease and in-process export-freeze remain held while the exact closed store and run inventories are hashed and through summary parent fsync; the still-held run-level lease is external and its persistent inode is revalidated

invariants: the complete intent and every immutable non-summary artifact it binds are written and fsynced before the revision-4 CAS
task_artifact_sha256 binds the exact proposed revision-4 task bytes and evidence_pack_artifact_sha256 binds the exact canonical persisted pack bytes
pre_summary_artifacts_sha256 binds the lexicographically keyed complete non-store artifact map excluding success-intent and run-summary
er3-finalize may only publish these already-bound bytes, close/snapshot the store, and write run-summary last

golden_external_preimages.scope: serialization-only completion vector that includes the long-lived control, environment-preimage, and journal singletons; it is not a valid live bundle and Gate B must prove the full closed live inventory

run_artifact_contract.path_contract: ASCII POSIX relative path with no absolute prefix, empty segment, dot segment, dot-dot segment, backslash, or duplicate normalization
run_artifact_contract.inventory_contract: while the external run-level lease, store writer lease, and store export-freeze remain held, recursively lstat the complete run root; require exactly live_required_directories plus the dynamic closed_store_family directories and accept only st_nlink==1 regular files admitted by live_required_singletons, live_required_artifact_families, and closed_store_family; close state/store to the exact tenant/task/idempotency inventory and include the zero-byte store writer lease; reject symlink, hardlink, socket, FIFO, device, temporary, staging, missing, extra, or unlisted empty path; publish and parent-fsync summary before releasing either lease
run_artifact_contract.summary_exclusion: run-summary.json is the only excluded final artifact and is canonicalized and written last; .run-summary.next is allowed only by summary_publication and is forbidden in every closed success or failed inventory

summary_publication.precondition: under exclusive run/store leases and export-freeze, run-summary.json is absent and the exact canonical summary bytes are deterministically bound by the revision-4 task, success intent, and freshly closed pre-summary inventory
summary_publication.write_protocol: create the fixed candidate directory-FD-relative with O_WRONLY|O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_CLOEXEC|O_NOFOLLOW mode 0600, write all bytes, fsync the file, validate bytes/owner/mode/device/link count, then use no-replace os.link with source and destination directory FDs to create run-summary.json; EEXIST is a conflict, never an overwrite; fsync the run-root directory, unlink the candidate, fsync the directory again, require the summary path to be one mode-0600 regular file with st_nlink 1 and exact bytes, and only then release the leases
summary_publication.crash_reentry: with the exclusive lease held, candidate-only accepts only an owner-matching bounded regular file: an incomplete candidate is unlinked and directory-fsynced before a deterministic retry, while a complete exact candidate resumes the no-replace link step; candidate plus summary is accepted only when both entries name the same inode and exact intent-bound bytes, after which candidate is unlinked and directory-fsynced; any independent, malformed, mismatched, linked, special, or preexisting summary entry fails without replacing or unlinking that summary
summary_publication.closed_inventory: neither candidate nor any other temp/staging entry may remain when success or terminal failure is classified

run_artifact_contract.replay_contract: acquire the shared run-level lease before the first root read and retain it through the repeated final inventory; verify externally supplied summary SHA-256 and full inventory before store open; recompute every command receipt from canonical JSON plus raw stdin/stdout/stderr, each stage operation's raw stdin and fixed writer argv, every inspect receipt and strict raw HostConfig/Config.Env projection from recorded inspect stdout, every cleanup receipt, Python/Git/Docker/socket/resource ownership, success intent, verified-fixture-set, preflight, seal, index/search/service/ruleset binding; prove the store contains exactly one tenant sidecar, one named task and its optional one-binding idempotency index; then repeat full inventory after replay without Docker or writes; host absolute paths in recorded control receipts make a bundle verifiable only on the originating host unless a future separately designed portable export rewrites them
run_artifact_contract.golden_scope: minimal serialization vector only; its explicit golden task projection is not runtime evidence; a live artifacts map contains every run-root regular file except run-summary.json
run_artifact_contract.empty_directory_invariants: docker-config-empty and docker-home-empty are mode-0700 owner-matching directories and remain recursively empty before and after every Docker command and at final inventory; every other non-store directory is present exactly once and contains only paths admitted by live_required_singletons or live_required_artifact_families; no additional empty directory is accepted

live_required_artifact_families.validation: canonical command JSON digest is recomputed from exact argv/environment/stdin/exit/stdout/stderr and raw stream artifacts; the first three operations prove zero matching pair-labeled resources; the ten-field command receipt also binds freshly observed private-binary and socket identities

one complete four-file group per sealed operation; stage stdin is the exact verified manifest content and every non-stage stdin is empty; the ten-field command receipt also binds freshly observed private-binary and socket identities

each five-file group recomputes a command receipt, strict raw HostConfig/Config.Env and normalized projection digest, and unique inspect receipt; its nested ten-field command receipt binds freshly observed private-binary and socket identities
one complete four-file group for docker_rm and each pair-labeled resource-list operation; the ten-field command receipt also binds freshly observed private-binary and socket identities
strict six-field raw response canonical digest

closed_store_family.conditional_file: state/store/tenant-v1-<sha256(tenant_id)>/idempotency.json exists iff the task idempotency key is non-null and contains exactly that one task binding
closed_store_family.cardinality: exactly one tenant directory, one task file, zero or one idempotency index, and no other store file or directory
closed_store_family.writer_lease_inode_policy: the store writer lease path is a permanent directory entry: never unlink, rename, truncate, or replace it; from store-lock acquisition through run-summary parent fsync, require the open locked FD and lstat of the path to retain equal device/inode, st_nlink 1, regular-file mode 0600, expected owner, and zero size
closed_store_family.freeze_seam: Gate B may add only a store export-freeze that holds the existing in-process lock and writer lease, validates and fsyncs the exact inventory, permits no mutation, and exits only after summary parent fsync
closed_store_family.forbidden: other tenant/task/index, migration/staging/temp file, ignored entry, symlink, hardlink, special file, or mutation after freeze begins

types_and_nullability.request.query_sha256: 64 lowercase hex equal to the manifest query hash

import hashlib
import os
import stat
import sys

path, size_text, expected = sys.argv[1:]
size = int(size_text, 10)
flags = os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW
fd = os.open(path, flags, 0o600)
ok = False
try:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    remaining = size
    while remaining:
        chunk = sys.stdin.buffer.read(min(65536, remaining))
        if not chunk:
            raise RuntimeError("short stdin")
        digest.update(chunk)
        view = memoryview(chunk)
        while view:
            written = os.write(fd, view)
            if written <= 0:
                raise RuntimeError("short write")
            view = view[written:]
        remaining -= len(chunk)
    if sys.stdin.buffer.read(1):
        raise RuntimeError("trailing stdin")
    os.fchmod(fd, 0o600)
    os.fsync(fd)
    metadata = os.fstat(fd)
    if not stat.S_ISREG(metadata.st_mode):
        raise RuntimeError("not regular")
    if stat.S_IMODE(metadata.st_mode) != 0o600:
        raise RuntimeError("mode mismatch")
    if metadata.st_nlink != 1 or metadata.st_size != size:
        raise RuntimeError("metadata mismatch")
    if metadata.st_uid != os.geteuid() or metadata.st_gid != os.getegid():
        raise RuntimeError("owner mismatch")
    if digest.hexdigest() != expected:
        raise RuntimeError("digest mismatch")
    ok = True
finally:
    os.close(fd)
    if not ok:
        try:
            os.unlink(path)
        except FileNotFoundError:
            pass

            raise RuntimeError("short stdin")
        digest.update(chunk)
        view = memoryview(chunk)
        while view:
            written = os.write(fd, view)
            if written <= 0:
                raise RuntimeError("short write")
            view = view[written:]
        remaining -= len(chunk)
    if sys.stdin.buffer.read(1):
        raise RuntimeError("trailing stdin")
    os.fchmod(fd, 0o600)
    os.fsync(fd)
    metadata = os.fstat(fd)
    if not stat.S_ISREG(metadata.st_mode):
        raise RuntimeError("not regular")
    if stat.S_IMODE(metadata.st_mode) != 0o600:
        raise RuntimeError("mode mismatch")
    if metadata.st_nlink != 1 or metadata.st_size != size:
        raise RuntimeError("metadata mismatch")
    if metadata.st_uid != os.geteuid() or metadata.st_gid != os.getegid():
        raise RuntimeError("owner mismatch")
    if digest.hexdigest() != expected:
        raise RuntimeError("digest mismatch")
    ok = True
finally:
    os.close(fd)
    if not ok:
        try:
            os.unlink(path)
        except FileNotFoundError:
            pass
